description: Layered deterministic technical system. Three independent layers (trend, momentum, risk) are normalized to a common scale and aggregated into sub-scores. The regime classifier (SMA + ADX) gates the final signal. The LLM is NOT a decision layer: it only audits BUY signals.

regime.description: Explicit regime classifier based on SMA(50/200) structure + ADX strength + directional movement (+DI/-DI).

rules.RANGE: ADX < adx_trend_min (no dominant trend, mean-reversion context)
rules.TRENDING_UP: ADX >= adx_trend_min AND SMA50 > SMA200 AND price > SMA200 AND +DI > -DI
rules.TRENDING_DOWN: ADX >= adx_trend_min AND SMA50 < SMA200 AND price < SMA200 AND -DI > +DI
rules.DISTRIBUTION: ADX >= adx_trend_min AND price > SMA200 (bullish structure) BUT -DI > +DI (selling pressure into highs)

trend.description: Directional structure of price. Output normalized to [-1, 1]. Weights are relative: when an indicator is unavailable (e.g. weekly_confirmation with insufficient history) the remaining weights are renormalized automatically.

sma_cross.norm: sign of (SMA50 - SMA200) scaled by relative gap via tanh

price_vs_sma200.norm: tanh of percentage distance of price above/below SMA200

weekly_confirmation.norm: 0.5*(weekly MA10>MA30 ? +1 : -1) + 0.5*(price>weekly MA10 ? +1 : -1); only applied when weekly history is sufficient

momentum.description: Speed/strength of price move. RSI + MACD are PRIMARY; Stoch RSI + ROC are SECONDARY. Output normalized to [-1, 1].

candlestick.norm: +1 for bullish patterns (HAMMER, ENGULFING), -1 for bearish; only added when a pattern is detected

bb_squeeze.norm: Bollinger bandwidth < 80% of its SMA -> squeeze (breakout energy); only added during squeeze

fib_support.norm: Price in Fibonacci golden zone (38.2%-61.8% retracement); 0.6 near 61.8%, 0.3 near 38.2%

rs_market.norm: tanh(scale * excess return vs relative_strength.market_benchmark over lookback days); only when benchmark data available

rs_sector.norm: tanh(scale * excess return vs the symbol's sector ETF (relative_strength.sector_etfs)); only when mapped and data available

risk.description: Penalty layer. Output normalized to [0, 1] where 0 = low risk, 1 = high risk. Volume and divergences live HERE, not in momentum.

volume_confirmation.norm: 0 when volume confirms move; up to 1 when volume is weak or OBV diverges

overbought.norm: (RSI - 70)/30 clipped, plus penalty if price at/above upper Bollinger Band

divergence.norm: 1.0 when bearish price/OBV or price/RSI divergence detected, else 0

market_context.norm: S&P500 trend as risk: bearish market = 1.0 (high risk), bullish = 0.0 (low risk); only when SP500 data available

overextension.norm: (price - EMA20) / ATR14 mapped linearly from start_atr (0 risk) to full_atr (1.0 risk)

vix.norm: VIX close mapped linearly from low (0 risk) to high (1.0 risk); only when VIX data available

decision.description: Deterministic decision gated by regime. The technical system is the sole decider.
decision.buy_threshold_note: The BUY threshold is driven by the MIN_BUY_CONFIDENCE env var (single knob, settable from GitHub Actions). 'buy_threshold_default' below is only the fallback used when that env var is unset.

risk_management.description: Entry/exit rules shared by production (google_handler.update_transactions) and the backtester (tools/backtesting.py). Changing any value is an engine change (Rule 1).
risk_management.exit_regimes_note: Close an open position at the current price when its regime becomes one of these (e.g. ["TRENDING_DOWN"]). Empty = disabled. Only symbols analysed in the run are checked.

relative_strength.description: Benchmarks for the rs_market / rs_sector momentum factors. Fetched once per run (yfinance) only when a factor has weight > 0 or shadow mode is on.

market_data.description: Index series used for market context. Production fetches them live; the backtest reads resources/historicals/market/<name>.csv.

backtest.description: Defaults for run_backtest_all.py. Each value mirrors a production env var and is overridden by it when set, so the backtest replays the exact production filter chain.
backtest.oos_note: Trades entered on/after oos_start are the out-of-sample holdout. Tune on in-sample only; accept a change only if out-of-sample does not degrade. The pre-2026-11 config was tuned on the full history, so its OOS figures are not a clean holdout.

shadow_mode.description: Signals that are collected and logged every run but NEVER affect a decision. Enable with SHADOW_MODE_ENABLED=true; persist history with SHADOW_LOG_FILE_ID. Evaluate later with evals/run/analyze_shadow.py and only then promote a signal (Rule 1).
shadow_mode.news_sentiment_note: Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT (free tier: 25 requests/day, shared with the history fallback). BUY candidates are scored first.

llm.description: Provider and model come from the LLM_PROVIDER ('openai' | 'anthropic') and MODEL_NAME repository variables; these are the per-provider defaults when MODEL_NAME is unset, plus Anthropic request options. Claude models take no temperature: effort controls depth/cost. Set anthropic_effort / anthropic_fallbacks to null for older Claude models that reject them.

llm_audit.description: The LLM is invoked ONLY when the technical system outputs BUY and LLM_AUDIT_ENABLED=true. It does NOT re-classify. It may adjust final confidence within bounds and flag incoherence. Recommended: disable (LLM_AUDIT_ENABLED=false) for more consistent signals — the technical engine is already robust.
